sections.description:
SIND WORKERS CHILDREN (EDUCATION) CESS RULES, 1974
SIND WORKERS CHILDREN (EDUCATION) CESS RULES, 1974
[No. 11 (18) 11/73‑Tax/11514.‑‑The
2nd October, 1974. Rotes framed by the Government of Sind in exercise of the
powers conferred by section 6 of the Workers" Children (Education)
Ordinance, 1972 (Ordinance No. XI of 1970. (Sind Govt. Gazette, Pt. IV‑A,
Oct. 31; 1974, p. 305.)]
1. (1) These rules may be
called the Sind Workers" Children (Educa tion) Cess Rules, 1974.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
(3) They shall extend to the
whole of the Province of Sind.
2. (1) In these rules,
unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the
meanings hereby respectively assigned to there, that is to say :‑
(a) "Cess" means the
cess payable under sub‑section (1) of Section 3 of the Ordinance;
(b) "Director, Excise and
Taxation" oceans the Director, Excise and Taxation of the Region concerned
and includes the Additional Director;
(c) "District Excise and
Taxation Officer" means an Excise and Taxation Officer of the district
concerned;
(d) "Form" means a form
appended to these rules, and includes a statement or communication on plain
paper containing roughly the same particulars as are specified in the
corresponding form;
(e) "Ordinance" means
the Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972 (Ordinance No. XI of 1972;
(f) "Return" means a
return prepared and delivered under sub section (2) of Section 3 of the
Ordinance;
(g) "Treasury" means a
treasury or sub‑treasury or a branch of a bank in Sind authorised to
receive payment on behalf of Government;
(h) "Year" means the
year commencing from 1st day of July, and ending on the next following 30th day
of June.
(2) All expressions used but not
defined in these rules shall have the meanings as are assigned to them in the
Ordinance.
3. (1) The return shall be
submitted an form EC‑I by every employer before the close of each quarter
to the District Excise and Taxation Officer in accordance with the provisions
contained in the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942.‑
(2) Every such return shall
indicate the highest number of workers employed in his establishment during the
proceeding quarter.
(3) The cess shall be due
annually and be payable as such by the date or dates as specified in the bill
of assessment .. issued by the Excise and Taxation Officer to each
individual employer liable to pay the cess.
Provided that the Employer may
assess and pay the cess at the rate of rupees twenty‑five per quarter per
worker and in such case the return shall be accompanied by a treasury challan:
Provided further that the return
for the quarter ending 30th June, shall be accompanied by a challan
representing the difference of the total cess calculated for the highest number
of workers attained during the year.
(4) The cess shall be due quarterly
and be payable as such by the date or slates as specified in the bill of
assessment . issued by the Excise and Taxation Officer to each individual
employer liable to pay the cess.
(5) if in the opinion of the
District Excise and Taxation Officer the amount assessed and paid by the
employer is less than the amount due be shall proceed to assess, the cess and
recover the difference in accordance with rule 5. .
4. (1) If any employer
fails or neglects to submit the return within the time prescribed under sub‑section‑(2)
of Section 3 of the Ordinance, the District Excise and Taxation Officer shall
serve. on him a notice in form FC‑II requiring him to submit a return
within such period as may be specified.
(2) If, in the opinion of the
District Excise and Taxation Officer, the return submitted by an employer is
not correct, or is not complete, or no such return has been furnished by the
employer, or is not furnished within the prescribed time, be shall, make such
enquiries as he deems fit and after giving such employer an opportunity of
